summary: Project is physically constructed. Turbines visible in Sentinel-2 imagery from Feb-Mar 2022. Approved for synchronization 2023-02-28 per ERCOT queue. Active staging yard (Wind Farm Laydown) confirmed via Google Maps Places at FM 3142, Raymondville TX. Post-sync stall of 40+ months with 33 COD changes indicates a non-construction blocker (interconnection studies, AEP transmission, or PPA issue), NOT a paper project.

cod_assessment.reasoning: 33 COD changes over 5 years. Project physically complete (turbines erected ~early 2022, approved for sync Feb 2023). Post-sync stall of 40+ months with continued monthly slippage is the key anomaly — indicates a non-construction blocker (interconnection punch-list, AEP transmission upgrade, ERCOT testing failure, or PPA renegotiation). Reported 2026-08-02 COD is almost certainly to slip again given the monthly pattern. Physical readiness supports eventual commercial operation; independent estimate 2026-Q4 to 2027-Q1 pending resolution of unknown blocker.
